query:
UPDATE users u
JOIN payments p ON p.userId = u.id
SET u.planTypeBiz = 'pro', u.bizMessageLimit = 999999, u.bizMessagesUsed = 0
WHERE p.status = 'confirmed' AND p.plan NOT LIKE '%founder%' AND u.planTypeBiz = 'free';

UPDATE users u
JOIN payments p ON p.userId = u.id
SET u.planTypeFounder = 'pro', u.founderMessageLimit = 999999, u.founderMessagesUsed = 0
WHERE p.status = 'confirmed' AND p.plan LIKE '%founder%' AND u.planTypeFounder = 'free';
